_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Headless, Not Homeless#001.src: Y-you?! But how!? They... You... You were executed! You are dead!!
Headless, Not Homeless#001.dst: 是、是你？！可是怎麼會！？他們……你……你已經被處決了！你已經死了！！
Headless, Not Homeless#001.speaker: Butler

Headless, Not Homeless#003.src: What's this commotion about? Can't I get some sleep for once in a while?
Headless, Not Homeless#003.dst: 吵什麼吵？我就不能偶爾好好睡一覺嗎？
Headless, Not Homeless#003.speaker: Noble

Headless, Not Homeless#004.src: Y-you?! Wha-... How are yo-... G-get off my property, right now! Guards!
Headless, Not Homeless#004.dst: 是、是你？！怎……你怎麼會……給、給我滾出我的地盤，馬上！衛兵！
Headless, Not Homeless#004.speaker: Noble

Headless, Not Homeless#005.src: You're the one responsible for my beheading, are you not?
Headless, Not Homeless#005.dst: 害我被斬首的人，就是你，不是嗎？
Headless, Not Homeless#005.speaker: Dullahan

Headless, Not Homeless#007.src: I shall now take everything of yours.
Headless, Not Homeless#007.dst: 現在，我要奪走你的一切。
Headless, Not Homeless#007.speaker: Dullahan

Headless, Not Homeless#008.src: N-no... I— Everyone thought it was you! I'm sorry, We're sorry!
Headless, Not Homeless#008.dst: 不、不……我……大家都以為是你！對不起，我們對不起你！
Headless, Not Homeless#008.speaker: Noble

Headless, Not Homeless#009.src: Some things can not be fixed with words.
Headless, Not Homeless#009.dst: 有些事，不是靠言語就能彌補的。
Headless, Not Homeless#009.speaker: Dullahan

Headless, Not Homeless#010.src: The remains reveal a lost memory...
Headless, Not Homeless#010.dst: 這些遺骸揭露了一段失落的記憶……
